title: Cartwise+ Membership Terms for Ending a Membership
content:
A customer ends a Cartwise+ Membership in one of two ways, and only the customer can confirm either.

**1. Turning off auto-renew.** Turning off auto-renew moves an active membership to pending cancellation; benefits continue until the end of the current paid period, and the membership is canceled with the reason "customer period end" on that date without a refund. Auto-renew can be turned back on only while the membership is still pending cancellation.

**2. Immediate cancellation.** An immediate cancellation (reason "customer immediate") is available from active and ends benefits on the day it is confirmed. Whether any money comes back is decided only by the fee refund rules.

**3. Trials.** A trial canceled before it converts (reason "trial canceled") is never charged.

**4. Who acts.** The agent registers the request on the customer's behalf and the customer confirms it; the agent never moves the status itself.

**5. What lapses.** On cancellation any unused Priority Delivery upgrades lapse, and the credit balance stays spendable for the plan's post-cancellation credit period after the canceled date before it expires.

## Cancel reasons

A canceled membership carries one of these five controlled reasons:

| Reason | Meaning |
|---|---|
| customer immediate | the customer confirmed an immediate cancellation from active |
| customer period end | the paid period ended with auto-renew off |
| trial canceled | the customer ended the membership during the trial |
| unpaid | the past-due grace period ran out with the fee unpaid |
| eligibility not verified | the required proof was not accepted within the proof window |

## Turning auto-renew back on — status table

| Membership status on the membership record | Auto-renew can be turned back on? |
|---|---|
| pending cancellation | yes |
| canceled | no |

## Comparison of the two ways to end

| | Turning off auto-renew | Immediate cancellation |
|---|---|---|
| Available from | active | active |
| Benefits end | at the end of the current paid period | on the day it is confirmed |
| Money back | none on this route | only as the fee refund rules decide |
| Confirmed by | the customer | the customer |
